# Refresh wordlists and data packs {#recipe-data-packs}

**Tool:** kailash (manifest data rows) · **Section:** Administrator ·
**Level:** easy · **Time:** ~10 minutes · **Layer/Category:** admin /
CLASSIC c-07 · **Tags:** admin, data-packs, wordlists

## Problem

Part of the catalogue is data, not commands: wordlists and data-pack
rows (the c-07 data-pack decision). You want to refresh them and know
what versions landed.

## Solution

<!-- PENDING: the data-pack refresh verbs land when proven against
the 2026.01 pin; the manifest's data rows describe the packs — the
recipe works the refresh path then. -->

Expected output shape:

```
pack: <name>
version: <rev>   (nvfetcher sources)
rows refreshed: <n>
```

## Discussion

Data packs are manifest rows like any other tool row (single source of
truth, six views, one truth) — a refresh is a lock/sources event, and
the provenance rules apply to them exactly as to tools.
